test_title: PYST 10: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 07 Feb, 2025 - Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Abhishek and Deepanshi undertake to do a piece of work for ₹1,000. Abhishek alone can do it in 5 days and Deepanshi alone can do it in 10 days. With the help of Chitransh, they finish it in 2 days. How much should Chitransh be paid for his contribution?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Work = LCM of given days (5, 10, 2) = 10 units.

Combined efficiency of all three = 10 ÷ 2 = 5 units/day.

Efficiency of Abhishek = 10 ÷ 5 = 2 units/day | Efficiency of Deepanshi = 10 ÷ 10 = 1 unit/day.

Efficiency of Chitransh = Total Efficiency − (Abhishek + Deepanshi) = 5 − 3 = 2 units/day.

Chitransh's Wage = (Chitransh's Efficiency ÷ Total Efficiency) × Total Amount = (2 ÷ 5) × 1000 = ₹400.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹400.**
